description: Retrospective application for erection of a single storey plant room on eastern boundary to serve the 29 retirement living units
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Location Plan; NL-2207-5-AC-152 Rev C;  Plant Noise Assessment R7064-1 Rev 1. Received 04/01/2019.
Plant Room External Finished Schedule. Received 27/02/2019.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall comply with Plant Room External Finished Schedule (as received 27/02/2019).

Condition : 4 - Any fixed external plant shall be designed and installed to ensure that noise emanating from such plant is at least 10 dB below the background noise levels when measured from the nearest sensitive receptors. All plant shall be installed in accordance with the approved plans. No further fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed."
